cases.question: Compare completed revenue in Q3 and Q4 2025. Return Q3 revenue, Q4 revenue and percentage growth rounded to two decimals.

result.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_date) = 7 THEN revenue_aed ELSE 0 END), 2) AS q3_revenue, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_date) = 10 THEN revenue_aed ELSE 0 END), 2) AS q4_revenue, ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_date) = 10 THEN revenue_aed ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_date) = 7 THEN revenue_aed ELSE 0 END)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_date) = 7 THEN revenue_aed ELSE 0 END), 0), 2) AS growth FROM completed_sales

payload.approach: This query calculates the completed revenue for Q3 and Q4 2025, and then calculates the percentage growth from Q3 to Q4. The EXTRACT function is used to extract the month from the order_date column, and the CASE statement is used to sum up the revenue for each quarter. The growth is calculated as (current - previous) / previous, and is rounded to two decimals.
